scope: Kinect color/depth streams in the five-sequence public fitability subset

world.name: HUMMAN_WORLD
world.definition: HuMMan world coordinates; the official release states that this frame is the same as kinect_color_000.

mhr_model.name: MHR_NATIVE
mhr_model.definition: Coordinates returned by the MHR TorchScript body model before the SAM 3D Body wrapper's output-axis conversion.
mhr_model.axes: implementation-defined until the wrapper conversion is applied
mhr_model.required_conversion: Use the same y/z sign conversion as the current SAM 3D Body head before comparing to OpenCV camera coordinates. Do not infer an extra rotation from appearance.

sam_output_camera.name: SAM_OPENCV_CAMERA
sam_output_camera.definition: MHR vertices after the current SAM 3D Body wrapper's axis conversion and predicted perspective camera translation.

camera_model.projection: u = fx * Xc/Zc + cx; v = fy * Yc/Zc + cy
camera_model.pixel_coordinates: integer array indices refer to pixel centres; u is column/x and v is row/y
camera_model.valid_projection: Zc > 0 and projected coordinates lie inside the target image
camera_model.opencv_opengl_rule: Dataset projection and scoring stay in OpenCV coordinates. Any renderer-specific OpenGL conversion must be explicit and must not change stored geometry.

extrinsics.warning: R,T are not camera-to-world. Their direction must not be changed to make an overlay look plausible.

depth.definition: Z-depth along the depth camera optical z axis, not Euclidean ray length
depth.scale_evidence: The release's Open3D code uses the default depth scale of 1000 and metric depth truncation.
depth.scale_validation_required: Before reporting millimetres, verify plausible human/camera distances and at least one known-scale or cross-view consistency check.

distortion.assumption: Use the released images and K with the release's pinhole workflow; assume no additional distortion correction only for reproducing that workflow.
distortion.claim_limit: Absence of coefficients does not prove zero physical lens distortion. This is a documented release assumption, not a calibrated fact.

rgb_depth_relation.registration_method: Unproject raw depth with K_depth, transform depth-camera to color-camera using the two world-to-camera extrinsics, project with K_color, then z-buffer into the color image.
rgb_depth_relation.interpolation_rule: Do not bilinearly mix foreground and background depth at discontinuities; use nearest valid projected depth with a z-buffer or operate directly on 3D points.
rgb_depth_relation.mask_relation: The inspected masks are 640x576 in the paired Kinect depth pixel frame. Apply the person mask before unprojection, then register selected 3D points into color with K/R/T.

mhr_placement.root_translation_definition: Use the current SAM 3D Body output pred_cam_t as the perspective camera-frame translation after the wrapper's documented conversion. Do not reinterpret it as HuMMan world translation.
mhr_placement.fitting_rule: If camera translation is optimized, it remains a Camera-A camera-frame parameter and is converted to world by Camera A's fixed calibration before Camera B evaluation.

mandatory_independent_tests.procedure: Transform sampled points world->camera->world for every selected color and depth camera.
mandatory_independent_tests.acceptance: maximum round-trip residual <= 5e-6 metres using the decimal-serialized release R/T; this tolerance was frozen before MHR fitting after observing <=2.13e-6 m and is not a surface-error gate

mandatory_independent_tests.procedure: Project depth-derived person points into the paired color image and compare their support with the released person mask and RGB silhouette.
mandatory_independent_tests.acceptance: Record overlap and boundary diagnostics; no fitting run is valid until gross flips, index swaps and scale errors are absent. A numeric threshold must be frozen after inspecting one development subject and before evaluating the remaining subjects.

mandatory_independent_tests.procedure: Transform valid Camera-A depth points to world and project them into Camera B using only official extrinsics/intrinsics.
mandatory_independent_tests.acceptance: The projection must agree with the synchronized Camera-B observation where the same surface is mutually visible; occlusions are excluded rather than forced to match.

mandatory_independent_tests.procedure: Project the unmodified SAM output through the declared MHR-to-OpenCV conversion and compare with the RGB person box/joints.
mandatory_independent_tests.acceptance: No additional manual axis swap, mirror, sign flip or scale factor is allowed after this contract is frozen.

known_unknowns: No distortion coefficients are present in the inspected HuMMan camera JSON.
The exact mask coordinate frame remains to be verified from the extracted mask dimensions and overlays.
The selected fit/test camera IDs and frame IDs remain pending visual QA.
Sensor depth bias and multipath behaviour have not been independently calibrated.
failure_policy: If registration or scale cannot be validated, mark the experiment INCONCLUSIVE_DATA_OR_OPTIMIZATION_LIMITED. Do not repair transforms by visual trial-and-error and do not score fitted SMPL as observed geometry.
